[[File:HAVwA6Juggernaut-FFp41.png|thumb|right|250px|A HAVw A6 Juggernaught]]
'''Heavy assault vehicles''', or '''HAVs''', were a type of heavily armored combat vehicle. The most well-known type of HAV was the [[Juggernaut]]-series of wheeled tanks produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook II">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
